“啧啧，不愧是瞿家的，狗改不了吃屎。”酒安嫌恶地低骂了一句。

而后对瞿爽道：“哭够了没？哭够了跟我们走一趟。”

他又看向汪潇，补了一句：“汪教授，您是失主，麻烦也跟着去一趟吧。”

汪教授看了看桌上一堆还没干完的活儿，无可奈何地叹了口气。他摘下围裙放在桌上，交代霖多多和彭源悠着点干，别累着，然后领着瞿爽出了门。

酒安走在最后。出门前，他的目光在上官程和霖多多两人身上来回扫了一圈，嘴角微微勾着，那表情似笑非笑，意味深长。

这眼神看得霖多多浑身不自在。等人都走远了她小声嘀咕：“他那个眼神什么意思啊？”

彭源一边收拾桌上的矿料，一边耸肩：“不懂。这大个子看上去挺吓人的，但……应该是个好人吧，还挺刚正不阿的。反正肯定不是瞿爽那边的人。”

“我也觉得。”霖多多点头，可眉头还是没松开，“但我怎么总有一种他认识我的错觉？你有没有听到他怎么喊我的？好像是——‘弟妹’？这称呼……是对自己弟弟的妻子吧？”

“有吗？”彭源歪头想了想，手上活没停，“我没注意听。八成是你听错了，他说的应该是‘妹子’或者‘老妹’？”

霖多多觉得不像，又转头看向上官程：“阿九，你耳朵好使，你说——他是不是喊我‘弟妹’了？”

上官程此刻已经在心里把酒安揍了千百遍了。

他看到瞿爽叫警察之后，就召唤常野去找酒安帮忙了。

酒安是他姑姑家的儿子，自小就体壮如牛，对体弱多病的上官程十分照顾。

那年上官程母亲刚去世，父亲又立刻续弦，大家都觉得他定是被上官家给弃了，于是明里暗里欺辱他，都是这位堂兄一拳一脚给他报复回去的。

只是这位哥，四肢虽然很发达，头脑却有些简单，学习成绩一塌糊涂，怎么补课都没用，为此经常挨父母的揍。后来还是小了三岁的上官程亲自给他辅导，才把成绩提了上去。

后来酒安如愿考入警校，上观程致力于商界。二人你帮我助，互补短板，既是兄弟也是搭档，关系不是一般的铁。

“快三十了还这么没脑子！胡喊八喊的！”上官程暗骂了一声。

霖多多眨了眨眼：“你说什么？”

“没说什么。”上官程垂下眼皮，声音平平的，“我……当时有点紧张，没听清。”

"Tsk tsk, you are indeed from the Qu family. A dog can't change its habit of eating shit." Jiu An cursed in disgust.

Then he said to Qu Shuang: "Have you cried enough? Come with us if you have cried enough."

He looked at Wang Xiao again and added: "Professor Wang, you are the owner, please come with me."

Professor Wang looked at the pile of unfinished work on the table and sighed helplessly.He took off his apron and put it on the table, told Lin Duoduo and Peng Yuan to take their time and don't get tired, and then led Qu Shuang out.

Jiu An walked last.Before going out, his eyes glanced back and forth at Shangguan Cheng and Lin Duoduo. The corners of his mouth were slightly hooked, and the expression was half-smile but not a smile, which was meaningful.

This look made Lin Duoduo feel uncomfortable all over.When everyone had gone away, she whispered: "What does that look in his face mean?"

Peng Yuan cleared up the mineral materials on the table and shrugged: "I don't understand. This big guy looks quite scary, but... he should be a good person, quite upright. Anyway, he is definitely not from Qu Shuang's side."

"I think so too." Lin Duoduo nodded, but his brows did not loosen, "But why do I always have the illusion that he knows me? Did you hear how he called me? It seemed like - 'brother and sister'? This title... is for his brother's wife, right?"

"Is there any?" Peng Yuan tilted his head and thought for a while, and kept working, "I didn't pay attention. You probably heard it wrong. He should have said 'sister' or 'old sister'?"

Lin Duoduo didn't think it was the case, so she turned to look at Shangguan Cheng: "Ajiu, you have a good ear, tell me - did he call me 'brother and sister'?"

Shangguan Cheng had already beaten Jiu An a thousand times in his heart.

After he saw Qu Shuang calling the police, he summoned Chang Ye to find Jiu An for help.

Jiu An is his aunt's son. He has been as strong as an ox since he was a child and takes great care of the frail and sick Shangguan Cheng.

Shangguan Cheng's mother had just passed away that year, and his father immediately remarried. Everyone felt that he must have been abandoned by the Shangguan family, so they bullied him overtly and secretly, and the cousin retaliated by punching and kicking him.

It's just that this brother, although his limbs are well developed, is a bit simple-minded. His academic performance is a mess, and no matter how much he makes up for it, it is useless. For this reason, he is often beaten by his parents.Later, Shangguan Cheng, who was three years younger, gave him personal tutoring and improved his grades.

Later, Jiu An got admitted to the police academy as he wished, and Shang Guancheng devoted himself to the business world.The two of you help each other and complement each other's weaknesses. They are both brothers and partners. Their relationship is not ordinary.

"You're almost thirty and you're still so clueless! You're just yelling nonsense!" Shangguan Cheng cursed secretly.

Lin Duoduo blinked: "What did you say?"

"I didn't say anything." Shangguan Cheng lowered his eyelids and said in a calm voice, "I... was a little nervous at the time and didn't hear clearly."
